tbesh_html:
1) to be humble, be humbled, be subdued, be brought down, be low, be under, be brought into subjection
1a) (Niphal)
1a1) to humble oneself
1a2) to be humbled, be subdued
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to humble
1b2) to subdue

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.
